name: USAspending state recipient profile
description: Detail hop off the state list already in the tree: name, code, fips, type, population + pop_year + pop_source, median_household_income + mhi_year + mhi_source, total_prime_amount, total_prime_awards, award_amount_per_capita. Normalises federal money against population for any state/territory FIPS.

name: USAspending federal account detail
description: Detail hop: fiscal_year, id, agency_identifier, main_account_code, account_title, federal_account_code, parent_agency_toptier_code + name, bureau_name + bureau_slug, total_obligated_amount, total_gross_outlay_amount, total_budgetary_resources, and children[] listing each TAS under the account with its own obligated/outlay/budgetary_resources.

name: USAspending agency profile
description: Detail hop off a toptier agency code: fiscal_year, toptier_code, name, abbreviation, agency_id, mission statement, website, congressional_justification_url, subtier_agency_count, and def_codes[] listing every disaster/emergency funding statute the agency draws on (code, public_law, title, govinfo URL, disaster type).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: USAspending agency sub-agency and office breakdown
description: Detail hop: each sub-tier agency (abbreviation, name, total_obligations, transaction_count, new_award_count) with a nested children[] array of the individual CONTRACTING OFFICES (code like 1234HK, name, obligations, transaction and new-award counts). Resolves federal money down to the specific office that signed it - 23 sub-agencies for USDA.

name: USAspending agency federal-account breakdown
description: 157 federal accounts for USDA FY2024, each with code, name, obligated_amount, gross_outlay_amount and children[] listing the treasury account symbols beneath it. The appropriations map of an agency.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: USAspending agency object-class breakdown
description: 30 object classes per agency-year with name, obligated_amount and gross_outlay_amount - what the money was spent ON (Grants subsidies and contributions, Insurance claims and indemnities, Personnel compensation, Equipment). Detects an agency's spending mix shifting.

name: USAspending agency program-activity breakdown
description: 457 named program activities for USDA FY2024 with obligated_amount and gross_outlay_amount (BENEFITS ISSUED, BELOW 130 OF POVERTY...). The programme dimension, finer than object class and usable as a filter back into award search.

name: USAspending federal obligations by account
description: 176 account rows per agency-year with account_title, account_number and obligated_amount, plus page_metadata carrying explicit next/current/previous URLs for exhaustive pagination.

name: USAspending agency data-quality overview
description: 111 agencies with agency_name, abbreviation, toptier_code, agency_id, current_total_budget_authority_amount, recent_publication_date, discrepancy_count, obligation_difference, unlinked contract/assistance award counts and assurance statement URL. This is the metadata that tells you how trustworthy an agency's reported spending is.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FPDS-NG contract award ATOM feed by vendor
description: The authoritative federal contract-writing system, keyless. 165 KB per page of Atom entries, each embedding the full FPDS award XML: awardID (PIID, modNumber, agencyID, referencedIDVID), relevantContractDates, dollarValues (obligatedAmount, baseAndExercisedOptionsValue, baseAndAllOptionsValue), purchaserInformation (contracting office agency + office code), vendor block (vendorName, UEI/CAGE/DUNS, full address, phone, business-size and socio-economic flags, parent vendor name and id), productOrServiceInformation (PSC, NAICS, principalNAICSCode), competition (extentCompeted, solicitationProcedures, numberOfOffersReceived, typeOfSetAside, evaluatedPreference) and placeOfPerformance. Query language accepts any FPDS field.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FPDS-NG contract detail feed by PIID
description: Detail hop: every base award and every modification sharing one PIID, in full FPDS XML (203 KB for the Navy ALE-70 contract). This is the complete amendment history of a single contract straight from the contract-writing system - the same trail USAspending exposes, but with FPDS's richer competition, set-aside and vendor-parent fields.

name: Federal Reserve enforcement actions (full history CSV)
description: 455 KB CSV, columns: Effective Date, Termination Date, Individual (the NAMED person barred or fined), Individual Affiliation (their bank and city/state), Banking Organization (for entity actions), Action (Prohibition from Banking, Written Agreement, Cease and Desist, Civil Money Penalty), URL to the press release, Name, Note. Both the institution-level and the named-individual-level enforcement record of the Federal Reserve, in one file, no scraping.

name: CFPB/FFIEC HMDA filer list
description: Every mortgage lender that reported HMDA loan records in a state-year, with lei (the Legal Entity Identifier - the global corporate key), name, count of loan records and period. 29 KB for California 2023. The LEI makes this joinable to GLEIF, SEC and FDIC data, and the count tells you a lender's origination volume in that state.

name: IRS Exempt Organizations BMF (region 4 / territories)
description: Same 28-column schema as eo1.csv covering the remaining IRS regions and US territories (Puerto Rico etc.). Collecting eo1 through eo4 gives the complete national EO Business Master File - roughly 1.8 million exempt entities with officer care-of names, assets, income and revenue.

name: CourtListener court registry
description: 3,359 courts, keyless: id (the court slug used as a filter everywhere else, e.g. scotus, cand, nysd), full_name, short_name, citation_string, jurisdiction, start/end dates, in_use, has_opinion_scraper, has_oral_argument_scraper, pacer_court_id and pacer_has_rss_feed. Needed to translate a court slug in a search hit into a real court, and to enumerate which courts have live PACER RSS feeds.

name: EPA ECHO — Detailed Facility Report (DFR)
description: THE deep hop: one FRS RegistryID expands into the full compliance dossier — MultipleFRSFacilities, Reports flags (HasPollRpt/HasAimRpt/HasBiosolidAnnualRpt/HasBflmRpt), and a Permits array carrying, per EPA system (FRS/ICIS-AIR/NPDES/RCRAInfo/SDWIS/TRI), the Statute, EPASystem, EPARegion, SourceID, facility name/address/FIPS/county, Universe, permit ExpDate, lat/lon, IndianCountry flag, SIC/NAICS and geocoding provenance. Downstream sections carry inspections, violations, formal/informal enforcement actions and penalties for that facility.

name: EPA ECHO — enforcement case detail report
description: Full record behind one enforcement case, keyed on ActivityId (NOT case number). Returns ActivityId, CaseNumber, CaseName, CaseType, CaseStatus + date, RegionalDocketNumber, DOJDocketNumber, Lead agency, ReliefSought, EnforcementOutcome, HeadquartersDivision, Branch, ResultVolDisclosure (voluntary self-disclosure), MultiMediaCase flag, EnforcementType, TotalFederalPenalty, TotalStatePenalty, PenaltyCollected, plus defendant/facility linkage, statutes and sections violated, milestones and compliance-action amounts.

name: EPA ECHO — bulk CSV export of a query
description: Dumps an entire ECHO query result set as CSV instead of paging get_qid. Columns are selected by index via qcolumns (1,2,3 = FacName, FacStreet, FacCity; RegistryID always included). 30,577 data rows in the observed response. Same qid-recycling caveat: take qid from the paired search call's QueryID.

name: EPA Envirofacts — TRI facility master
description: Toxics Release Inventory reporting facilities. Per row: tri_facility_id, facility_name, street_address, city_name, county_name, state_county_fips_code, state_abbr, zip_code, EPA region, fac_closed_ind, and the full mailing-address block (mail_name/street/city). Filter by any column: /efservice/tri_facility/<column>/<value>/rows/0:N/JSON. Joins straight into tri_reporting_form.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA Envirofacts — TRI Form R submissions
description: One row per chemical per facility per reporting year. doc_ctrl_num (the join key to release/transfer quantities), tri_facility_id, tri_chem_id, form_type_ind, reporting_year, certif_name and certif_official_title (the NAMED EXECUTIVE who signed the toxics report), certif_signature, certif_date_signed, postmark_date, partial_fac/entire_fac, max_amount_of_chem, active_status.

name: EPA Envirofacts — TRI chemical dictionary
description: Resolves tri_chem_id to a substance: chem_name, active_date/inactive_date, caac_ind (Clean Air Act chemical), carc_ind (carcinogen), r3350_ind, metal_ind, feds_ind, classification, pbt_start_year (persistent bioaccumulative toxic).

name: EPA Envirofacts — FRS program-system facility crosswalk
description: Maps a facility to every EPA programme system it appears in — filter by pgm_sys_acrnm (RCRAINFO, ICIS-AIR, NPDES, TRIS, SDWIS, AIRS/AFS, CERCLIS, EIS, GHG) and by state_code. Carries location_address, std_full_address, std_city_name, country_name, tribal_land_name, federal_agency_code, standardised street components, create/update/refresh dates. This is the join table that lets one company name reach all its permits.

name: EPA Envirofacts — FRS facility site master
description: The Facility Registry Service master record — the canonical EPA identity for a regulated site. state_name, location_address, std_full_address and standardised address components (std_base_name, std_stype_before/after, std_city_name), country_name, tribal_land_name, federal_agency_code, parent linkage, user_id/create_date/update_date provenance. Registry ID here is the key used by ECHO's DFR.

name: EPA SDWIS — public water system master
description: Every regulated public water system. pwsid (the key for the whole SDWIS family), pws_name, primacy_agency_code, epa_region, season_begin/end_date, pws_activity_code, pws_deactivation_date, pws_type_code (CWS/TNCWS/NTNCWS), gw_sw_code (groundwater/surface), dbpr and lt2 schedule categories, cds_id, population served. Pivots directly to that system's drinking-water violations.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA SDWIS — physical facilities within a water system
description: Wells, intakes, treatment plants and storage inside a PWS: pwsid, facility_id, facility_name, state_facility_id, facility_activity_code, facility_deactivation_date, facility_type_code, submission_status_code, is_source_ind, water_type_code, availability_code, seller/treatment linkage. Lets a violation be pinned to a specific well or plant.

name: EPA PCS — NPDES permitted discharger master
description: Permit Compliance System discharger record: npdes (permit number, the join key), name_1 and name_2 (facility and process description), major_discharge_indicator, region, city_code/city_name, county_code/county_name, state, SIC, permit dates. Pivots to that permit's inspections and enforcement actions.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA ICIS — facility interest records
description: Facility-side of ICIS-NPDES: location_address, city, state, zip, geocoding coordinates and format code, facility UIN, federal/state flag. Joins ICIS permits to physical sites and to FRS.

name: EPA RCRA Biennial Report — hazardous waste generation
description: Biennial hazardous-waste report rows: handler_id (EPA Handler ID), activity_location (state), source_type (B = biennial), sequence number, waste description, generation quantity, management method and receiving facility. The tonnage behind a RCRA generator.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: EPA GHGRP — greenhouse gas reporting facility dimension
description: Mandatory greenhouse-gas reporters: facility_id, facility_name, latitude/longitude, address1/address2, city, state, state_name, zip, county and county_fips, naics_code, reporting year, bamm_used_desc (best-available-monitoring-method), emission classification. facility_id joins to sector emissions.

name: openFDA — 510(k) clearance detail by K-number
description: DETAIL HOP on a device clearance: k_number, applicant, contact, address_1/2, city/state/postal_code/country_code, date_received, decision_date, decision_code/description, clearance_type, product_code, advisory_committee and description, review_advisory_committee, statement_or_summary, third_party_flag, expedited_review_flag, device_name, plus the openfda block (device_class, regulation_number, medical_specialty_description). Links a marketed device back to the firm that cleared it.

name: openFDA — PMA premarket approval detail by PMA number
description: DETAIL HOP: pma_number, supplement_number and supplement_type/reason, applicant, street/city/state/zip, generic_name, trade_name, product_code, advisory_committee, date_received, decision_date, decision_code, expedited_review_flag, ao_statement (the approval-order text), docket_number, and openfda device_class/regulation_number. The highest-scrutiny device approval record.

name: openFDA — Unique Device Identifier record detail
description: DETAIL HOP into the GUDID: public_device_record_key, public_version_number/date/status, device_description, brand_name, version_or_model_number, catalog_number, company_name, labeler DUNS, identifiers[] (GTIN/DI values and issuing agency), device_sizes, sterilization info, mri_safety, is_rx/is_otc/is_kit/is_combination_product, has_lot_or_batch_number/serial_number/expiration_date, product_codes[], customer_contacts[], device_publish/commercial_distribution dates.

name: openFDA — device product-code classification detail
description: DETAIL HOP that resolves the product_code appearing on every MAUDE report, recall and 510(k): device_name, medical_specialty_description, device_class, regulation_number, definition, physical_state, technical_method, target_area, gmp_exempt_flag, implant_flag, life_sustain_support_flag, third_party_flag, review_panel, submission_type_id, unclassified_reason.

name: openFDA — device enforcement report detail by recall number
description: DETAIL HOP on the formal FDA enforcement report: recall_number, classification (Class I/II/III), status, recalling_firm and full address, event_id, product_type, product_description, product_quantity, code_info, reason_for_recall, recall_initiation_date, center_classification_date, termination_date, report_date, distribution_pattern, initial_firm_notification, voluntary_mandated, and openfda linkage.

name: openFDA — drug enforcement report detail by recall number
description: DETAIL HOP: full FDA drug recall enforcement record — recall_number, classification, status, recalling_firm, city/state/country/postal_code, event_id, product_description, product_quantity, code_info, reason_for_recall, recall_initiation_date, center_classification_date, termination_date, report_date, distribution_pattern, initial_firm_notification, voluntary_mandated, plus openfda (application_number, brand_name, generic_name, manufacturer_name, product_ndc, substance_name, unii, spl_id).

name: openFDA — Drugs@FDA application detail by NDA/ANDA/BLA number
description: DETAIL HOP: application_number, sponsor_name, products[] (product_number, reference_drug, brand_name, active_ingredients[] with strength, dosage_form, route, marketing_status, te_code), submissions[] — every supplement with submission_type, submission_number, submission_status and date, review_priority, submission_class_code_description, and application_docs[] with URLs to the approval letters, labels and review packages.

name: openFDA — National Drug Code directory detail
description: DETAIL HOP: product_ndc, generic_name, labeler_name, brand_name and suffix, active_ingredients[], finished flag, packaging[] (package_ndc, description, marketing_start_date, sample flag), listing_expiration_date, marketing_category, dosage_form, route[], product_type, marketing_start/end_date, application_number, pharm_class[], dea_schedule. Resolves an NDC seen on a recall or adverse event back to its labeler.

name: openFDA — food recall enforcement detail by recall number
description: DETAIL HOP: recall_number, classification, status, recalling_firm with full address, event_id, product_type, product_description, product_quantity, code_info, reason_for_recall, recall_initiation_date, center_classification_date, termination_date, report_date, distribution_pattern, initial_firm_notification, voluntary_mandated, more_code_info.

name: openFDA — FDA historical document archive
description: 8,858 documents. Per record: doc_type, title, text/body, num (document number) and date. Endpoint the tree does not currently carry; useful for archival FDA notices and regulatory correspondence.

name: NHTSA — consumer safety complaints by vehicle
description: 345 complaints for one make/model/year. Each: odiNumber, manufacturer, crash and fire booleans, numberOfInjuries, numberOfDeaths, dateOfIncident, dateComplaintFiled, partial VIN, components (POWER TRAIN, ENGINE, FUEL/PROPULSION SYSTEM…), and the free-text summary written by the owner. This is the raw defect-signal layer under a recall.

name: NHTSA — recall detail by campaign number
description: DETAIL HOP: expands one NHTSA recall campaign into all affected model rows. Per row: Manufacturer, NHTSACampaignNumber, parkIt / parkOutSide / overTheAirUpdate flags, ReportReceivedDate, Component, PotentialNumberofUnitsAffected (5,376 in the observed record), Summary, Consequence, Remedy, Notes, ModelYear/Make/Model. 'recall → affected units' exactly as required.

name: NHTSA vPIC — all registered vehicle manufacturers
description: 100 manufacturers per page. Per row: Mfr_ID, Mfr_Name, Mfr_CommonName, Country, VehicleTypes[] with IsPrimary flag. The enumeration list whose Mfr_Name feeds the manufacturer-detail hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NHTSA vPIC — manufacturer corporate detail
description: DETAIL HOP: 14 registered entities matching 'honda'. Per entity: Mfr_ID, Mfr_Name, Mfr_CommonName, Address, Address2, City, State/PostalCode, Country, ContactEmail, ContactPhone, ContactFax, DBAs, PrincipalFirstName/LastName, ManufacturerTypes[], VehicleTypes[], EquipmentItems[], LastUpdated. Named contacts and addresses for every vehicle/equipment manufacturer registered with NHTSA.

name: CPSC SaferProducts — recall detail by RecallID
description: DETAIL HOP: RecallID, RecallNumber, RecallDate, Description, URL, Title, ConsumerContact, LastPublishDate, plus nested arrays Products[] (Name, Description, Model, Type, CategoryID, NumberOfUnits), Inconjunctions[], Images[], Injuries[], ManufacturerCountries[], ProductUPCs[], Hazards[] (HazardType, Name), Remedies[], RemedyOptions[], Retailers[], Distributors[], Importers[], Manufacturers[] (company name + country). Recall → affected units, hazards, and the whole supply chain named.

name: CPSC SaferProducts — recall lookup by recall number
description: Same full recall envelope as RecallID but keyed on the public RecallNumber string as printed on notices (dashes are optional: 24-001 resolves to RecallNumber '24001'). Useful when pivoting from a press release or a retailer notice.

name: CPSC SaferProducts — recall search by product name
description: 85 recalls matching 'helmet', each a complete recall record (not a stub) with Products/Hazards/Injuries/Manufacturers/Importers/Retailers arrays. Free-text product pivot the tree lacks — the tree only carries the RecallDateStart form.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CPSC SaferProducts — recalls in a date window
description: 902 KB covering H1-2026 recalls with the full nested envelope per recall (Products, Hazards, Injuries, Remedies, Manufacturers, Importers, Retailers, Distributors, ManufacturerCountries, ProductUPCs). The bounded-window form for incremental crawling; RecallDateEnd is the parameter the tree's existing open-ended call omits.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CMS Care Compare — dataset catalogue (DKAN metastore)
description: 550 KB DCAT catalogue of every Care Compare dataset with identifier (the 4x4 used by /datastore/query/{id}/0), title, description, theme, keyword[], modified/released/nextUpdateDate, publisher, contactPoint and distribution downloadURL. This is how you discover the nursing-home, hospital, hospice, home-health and dialysis enforcement tables without hardcoding ids.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CMS Care Compare — single dataset metadata
description: DETAIL HOP on the catalogue: accessLevel, landingPage, bureauCode, issued/modified/released/nextUpdateDate, keyword[] with identifiers ('Complaints', 'Deficiencies'), publisher, contactPoint, describedBy (data dictionary), temporal coverage and distribution[] with the CSV downloadURL and the datastore resource identifier.

name: CMS Open Data — DCAT catalogue
description: 3 MB Project Open Data catalogue for data.cms.gov. Per dataset: title, description, accrualPeriodicity, contactPoint, describedBy (data dictionary URL), and distribution[] where the entry carrying description:'latest' holds the STABLE accessURL https://data.cms.gov/data-api/v1/dataset/{uuid}/data. This is the authoritative way to resolve the provider-enrollment, ownership, change-of-ownership and revalidation dataset uuids used below.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CMS — Medicare Fee-For-Service public provider enrollment
description: 2,978,925 rows (confirmed via the /data/stats endpoint). Per provider: NPI, MULTIPLE_NPI_FLAG, PECOS_ASCT_CNTL_ID (the PECOS associate id that links individuals to organisations), ENRLMT_ID, PROVIDER_TYPE_CD and PROVIDER_TYPE_DESC, STATE_CD, FIRST_NAME/MDL_NAME/LAST_NAME, ORG_NAME. Server-side filtering works: ?filter[NPI]=... returns the single record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CMS — Medicare opt-out affidavits
description: Clinicians who have formally opted out of Medicare. Fields: First Name, Last Name, NPI, Specialty, Optout Effective Date, Optout End Date, First Line Street Address, Second Line Street Address, City Name, State Code, Zip code, 'Eligible to Order and Refer' flag, Last updated. Addresses and dates for every opted-out practitioner.

name: CMS — Medicare order-and-referring eligibility
description: Which clinicians are legally eligible to order/refer, by programme: NPI, LAST_NAME, FIRST_NAME, and Y/N flags for PARTB, DME, HHA, PMD, HOSPICE. Refreshed every 3.5 days. A clinician who loses a flag has effectively been cut off — a direct enforcement signal.

name: CMS — provider revalidation due date list
description: Enrollment ID, National Provider Identifier, First/Last Name, Organization Name, Enrollment State Code, Enrollment Type, Provider Type Text, Enrollment Specialty, Revalidation Due Date, Adjusted Due Date, Individual Total Reassign To, Receiving Benefits Reassignment count. A missed revalidation is how providers get deactivated — the leading indicator of removal from Medicare.

name: CMS — revalidation clinic group practice reassignment
description: The individual-to-group affiliation graph: Group PAC ID, Group Enrollment ID, Group Legal Business Name, Group State Code, Group Due Date, Group Reassignments and Physician Assistants count, Record Type ('Reassignment'), Individual Enrollment ID, Individual NPI, Individual First/Last Name, Individual specialty, state and due date. Shows exactly which clinicians bill under which practice entity.

name: CMS — revalidation reassignment list
description: Group PAC ID, Group Enrollment ID, Group Legal Business Name, Group State Code, Group Due Date, Group Reassignments and Physician Assistants, Record Type, Individual PAC ID, Individual Enrollment ID, Individual NPI and name, Individual Specialty Description, Individual State Code and Due Date. Second view of the billing-reassignment network.

name: CMS — Provider of Services file (iQIES)
description: 12 KB for 2 rows — the full certification record for every non-hospital Medicare provider: prvdr_num (CCN), fac_name, prvdr_sbtyp_id, mdcd_vndr_num, orgnl_prtcptn_dt (original participation date), prvdr_type_id, st_adr, city_name, ssa_cnty_cd, zip_cd, phne_num, crtfctn_dt, TRMNTN_EXPRTN_DT (termination/expiration date — i.e. when CMS cut them off), state_cd, ssa_state_cd, plus scores of certification, bed-count and service-offering fields.

name: CMS Open Payments — dataset catalogue
description: 127 KB DKAN catalogue of all 65 Open Payments datasets (general, research and ownership payment detail per reporting year 2013-2025, plus profile files). Each record's distribution[0].identifier is the id used by /api/1/datastore/query/{id}. The tree carries only the bare /datastore/query/ path with no dataset id — this resolves them.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FMCSA — motor carrier census (SAFER replacement)
description: Keyless substitute for the 403-blocked QCMobile/SAFER APIs. Per carrier: dot_number, status_code, add_date, mcs150_date, mcs150_mileage and year, dun_bradstreet_no, carrier_operation (interstate/intrastate), business_org_id, phy_omc_region, safety_inv_terr, legal and DBA name, physical and mailing address, phone, power units, driver count, hazmat flags, cargo-carried flags, and the safety rating with its rating date. Verified server-side filter ?dot_number=162845.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FMCSA — motor carrier crash file
description: CARRIER → ITS CRASHES, the exact detail hop required. Per crash: crash_id, dot_number, report_state, report_number, report_date and time, report_seq_no, ci_status_code, final_status_date, location, state, county, fatalities, injuries, tow_away flag, vehicle configuration, hazmat released flag, weather and light conditions, road access control, trafficway description, and citation issued. Verified filter ?dot_number=728630.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FMCSA — roadside vehicle inspection file
description: CARRIER → ITS ROADSIDE INSPECTIONS. Per inspection: inspection_id, dot_number, report_state, report_number, insp_date, insp_start_time/insp_end_time, region, ci_status_code, location_desc, inspection level, driver and vehicle out-of-service counts and OOS totals, hazmat inspection flag, unsafe-driving and fatigued-driving violation counts, and the vehicle/licence-plate identifiers. Verified filter ?dot_number=728630.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: FMCSA — carrier authority status (all with history)
description: Per docket: docket_number, dot_number, common_stat / contract_stat / broker_stat (A=active, I=inactive, N=none), common_app_pend / contract_app_pend / broker_app_pend (pending applications), common_rev_pend / contract_rev_pend / broker_rev_pend (PENDING REVOCATIONS), property_chk, passenger/household-goods/enterprise flags. Live view of which authorities a carrier holds and which are being revoked.

name: FRA — highway-rail grade crossing incidents (Form 57)
description: Every railroad grade-crossing collision reported to the Federal Railroad Administration. Per incident: railroadcode, railroadname, year, incidentnumber, incidentyear/month, maintenancerailroadcode and name, crossing id, location, train speed, vehicle type and speed, warning devices present, driver action, weather and visibility, killed and injured counts, hazmat involvement and release. Railroad → its crossing casualties.

name: US DOJ — press release API (enforcement announcements)
description: 270,751 records. Per release: title, body (full HTML text), date, uuid, url, teaser, component[] (which DOJ component or US Attorney's Office), topic[] (Health Care Fraud, FCPA, Environmental Crimes, Antitrust…), changed date, attachment. Paged with ?page= and ?pagesize=. The narrative enforcement layer that names defendants, penalties and pleas before structured datasets catch up. metadata.resultset gives count/pagesize/page for honest bounded views.

name: CourtListener RECAP — federal docket search (anonymous-accessible)
description: Federal PACER/RECAP dockets. count 98124 dockets / document_count 520436 for one query. Each row carries docketNumber, caseName, court, assignedTo judge name + assigned_to_id, referredTo, dateFiled, dateTerminated, cause, natureOfSuit, juryDemand, and a nested recap_documents[] array with entry_number, description, is_available, filepath_local and page_count. This is the deep RECAP hop that works WITHOUT a token (the REST /dockets/ endpoint is 401 anonymously).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CourtListener RECAP — docket-entry/document search
description: Individual RECAP docket ENTRIES and their PDFs, count 5,056,495 for one term. Each row: absolute_url to /docket/{id}/{entry}/, entry_number, description of the filed paper, short_description, document_number, attachment_number, is_available, filepath_local, page_count, docket_id, court and caseName. Turns a name into the actual filings against it.

name: CourtListener — docket-level search (type=d)
description: Docket-header view: count 11853 for one party name. Fields include assignedTo (judge), assigned_to_id, docketNumber, court_id, caseName, dateFiled, dateTerminated, chapter (bankruptcy), trustee_str, suitNature. Deduplicated per docket, so it is the right entry point for 'every case this company is in'.

name: CourtListener — opinion / case-law search
description: Published opinions across 3,359 courts, count 1,097,566 for one term. Rows carry cluster id, caseName, court, dateFiled, citation strings, judge, status (Published/Unpublished), snippet text and absolute_url. Cursor-paginated.

name: CourtListener — judge search (type=p)
description: Federal and state judges, count 664 for one surname. Rows carry id, name_full, absolute_url, court list, appointer, selection_method, aba_rating array, political_affiliation, school, date_start/date_termination. The id feeds every judge detail hop below.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CourtListener — oral argument audio search
description: Oral-argument recordings, count 1624 for one term. Rows give absolute_url to /audio/{id}/, caseName, court, dateArgued, docketNumber, duration and the mp3 local path.

name: CourtListener — judicial positions held by a person
description: Every seat a judge has held: position_type, court, organization_name, job_title, date_nominated, date_elected, date_confirmation, date_start, date_termination, termination_reason, how_selected, appointer (link to the appointing person), supervisor, predecessor, voice_vote / votes_yes / votes_no on confirmation, and nested retention_events[]. The appointer field makes this a person->person graph.

name: CourtListener — judge political affiliation history
description: Party affiliation records for a judge with political_party, source (ballot/appointer/bar/other), date_start, date_end and granularity. Detail hop off a person id.

name: CourtListener — ABA judicial nominee ratings
description: American Bar Association ratings of a judicial nominee: year_rated and rating (Well Qualified / Qualified / Not Qualified), keyed to the person. Detail hop off a person id.

name: CourtListener — federal judge financial disclosure filings
description: Annual EIGA financial-disclosure reports filed by federal judges: id, year, page_count, filepath (scanned PDF), thumbnail, has_been_extracted, is_amended, addendum_content_raw, plus report_type. The id is the parent key for the seven line-item endpoints below (investments, gifts, debts, agreements, reimbursements, spouse income, outside positions).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CourtListener — judge disclosure: investments / assets
description: Line-item holdings from a judge's financial disclosure: page_number, description of the asset, redacted flag, income_during_reporting_period_code and _type, gross_value_code and _method, transaction_during_reporting_period, transaction_date, transaction_value_code, transaction_gain_code, transaction_partner. This is the conflict-of-interest layer behind a judge.

name: CourtListener — judge disclosure: gifts received
description: Gifts reported by a federal judge: source (who gave it), description, value, redacted flag, tied to the parent financial_disclosure id and thence to the judge.

name: CourtListener — judge lookup by surname
description: Name-filtered judge lookup (name_last, name_first also supported) returning the full person record incl. embedded aba_ratings. The entity-pivot form: feed a surname, get the person id, then walk positions/educations/disclosures.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: US Supreme Court — full docket record (JSON)
description: The complete SCOTUS docket for one case number, straight from supremecourt.gov and completely keyless. Contains CaseNumber, term, case type (Paid/IFP/Application), PetitionerTitle, RespondentTitle, DocketedDate, LowerCourt + lower-court docket numbers and decision date, RelatedCaseNumber[], Petitioner[] and Respondent[] arrays of counsel (name, firm, address, phone, party represented), Other[] (amici counsel), and ProceedingsandOrder[] — 53 dated docket entries here — each with Date, Text and a Links[] array of DocumentUrl PDFs on supremecourt.gov/DocketPDF/. Docket -> entries -> documents in a single hop. Works for merits dockets (24-1234) and applications (24A1012).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: US Supreme Court — slip opinions feed
description: Newest SCOTUS slip opinions with title, link to the PDF on supremecourt.gov and pubDate. The docket numbers in the titles feed straight into the SCOTUS docket JSON endpoint above.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Oyez — Supreme Court cases by term
description: Keyless SCOTUS case index. Each case: ID, name, href (api.oyez.org/cases/{term}/{docket}), docket_number, additional_docket_numbers, timeline[] of events (Granted/Argued/Decided with unix dates), lower_court, facts_of_the_case, question, conclusion, term, and labelled issue areas.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Oyez — Supreme Court case full record
description: Full expanded SCOTUS case: facts, question presented, conclusion, lower court and its ruling, plus hrefs into every sub-resource — case_advocate/{id} (the arguing lawyers), case_citation/{id}, case_decision/{id}, case_document/written_opinion/{id}, case_media/oral_argument_audio/{id}, case_media/opinion_announcement_audio/{id}, case_timeline/{id}, decision_vote/{id} (per-justice vote), and courts/{natural-court}. Every one of those hrefs is itself a live keyless endpoint.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Oyez — single justice vote record
description: One justice's vote in one case: nested member object with ID, full name, href, last_name and roles[] (type scotus_justice, date_start, date_end, appointing_president, role_title), plus the vote value, opinion_type and joining information.

name: Oyez — written opinion document
description: An individual opinion attached to a case: id, title (Majority/Concurring/Dissenting), author, type value+label, justia_opinion_id and justia_opinion_url, media_files and opinion_body. Third hop: case -> case_document href -> this record.

name: Oyez — natural court composition
description: A 'natural court' (a stable bench composition, e.g. roberts13 = Roberts Court 2022-): ID, name, date range, and members[] — every sitting justice with ID, name, href to their person record, roles and service dates. Lets you resolve who was on the Court on any date.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Oyez — justice / advocate biography
description: Person record for a justice or advocate: ID, full name parts and suffix, date_of_birth and place_of_birth (unix + string), date_of_death, gender, roles[] with appointing_president, seat, date_start/date_end, plus thumbnail and identifier slug.

name: Oyez — advocate roster
description: Every lawyer who has argued before the Supreme Court in Oyez's coverage: ID, name, href to /people/{identifier}, last_name, length_of_service, identifier. Paginated list; the entry point for 'which cases did this lawyer argue'.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Oyez — full case index (paginated)
description: The whole Oyez SCOTUS case corpus back to the 1950s, paginated: ID, name, href, docket_number, timeline[] with decided/argued dates, and term. Feed each href to the case-detail hop.

name: US Tax Court (DAWSON) — full public case record
description: Keyless full docket for a Tax Court case: caseCaption, docketNumber(+suffix), createdAt, partyType, judge, and three deep arrays — docketEntries[] (index, filingDate, receivedAt, documentTitle, documentType, eventCode, filedBy, filedByRole, servedAt, servedPartiesCode, numberOfPages, isFileAttached, isSealed, isStricken, attachments, objections, lodged, signedJudgeName, docketEntryId), petitioners[] (name, state, contactId, serviceIndicator), irsPractitioners[] and privatePractitioners[] (name, barNumber, originalBarState, practiceType, practitionerType, admissionsDate, admissionsStatus). Case -> entries -> parties -> counsel in one request.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: US Tax Court (DAWSON) — order full-text search
description: Full-text search across Tax Court orders. Each result: caseCaption, docketNumber(+suffix), documentTitle, documentType, eventCode, filingDate, signedJudgeName and docketEntryId. The docketNumber pivots straight to the case-detail endpoint and the docketEntryId to the signed PDF URL endpoint. Supports dateRange=customDates&startDate=&endDate= and judge filters.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Caselaw Access Project — reporter volume index
description: Harvard CAP's full static corpus (api.case.law is retired; this R2 bucket replaces it and is keyless). One reporter (a2d = Atlantic Reporter 2d) lists 967 volumes with volume_number, title, publisher, publication_year, start_year/end_year and jurisdictions[] (id, name, name_long, slug). The bucket root https://static.case.law/ lists every reporter slug.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Caselaw Access Project — cases in a volume
description: Every case in one reporter volume: id, name, name_abbreviation, decision_date, docket_number, first_page/last_page, citations[] (type official/parallel, cite), court object, jurisdiction, and the file_name that forms the case-detail path. Second hop of the CAP chain.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GovTrack — legislator detail record
description: Keyless member-of-Congress record: bioguideid, birthday, cspanid, firstname/middlename/lastname/namemod, gender, twitterid, youtubeid, osid (OpenSecrets), pvsid (VoteSmart), fediverse_webfinger, and link to the GovTrack profile. Detail hop from any /role or /vote_voter row's person id. (Only /role, /bill and /vote are already in the tree — this one is not.)

name: GovTrack — congressional committees and subcommittees
description: 355 committees/subcommittees: code, abbrev, name, committee_type (house/senate/joint), jurisdiction text, url, and the parent committee object for subcommittees.

name: GovInfo bulk data — bill status XML (KEYLESS)
description: The complete BILLSTATUS XML for a bill with NO API KEY at all: <bill> with number, updateDate, originChamber, type, introducedDate, policyArea, <sponsors>, <cosponsors>, <actions> (every dated action with actionCode and committee), <committees> with activities, <relatedBills>, <subjects>, <summaries>, <titles>, <textVersions>, <amendments>, <laws>. Everything the keyed Congress.gov API charges rate limit for, free. Pattern: /bulkdata/BILLSTATUS/{congress}/{hr|hres|hjres|hconres|s|sres|sjres|sconres}/BILLSTATUS-{congress}{type}{num}.xml

name: eCFR — CFR title index and currency
description: All 50 CFR titles, keyless: number, name, latest_amended_on, latest_issue_date, up_to_date_as_of, reserved. The freshness ledger for the whole Code of Federal Regulations and the entry point for the versioner endpoints.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: eCFR — agency registry with CFR references
description: 316 federal agencies: name, short_name, display_name, sortable_name, slug, children[] (sub-agencies), and cfr_references[] giving the exact title/chapter each agency owns. Maps an agency to the regulations it writes.

name: eCFR — ancestry of a CFR node
description: Given a title plus part/subpart/section, returns the full chain of ancestors (title -> chapter -> subchapter -> part) with identifier, label, label_level, label_description and size. Resolves a bare CFR citation into its regulatory context.

name: eCFR — official corrections to the CFR
description: Published corrections against a CFR title: id, cfr_references[] with the exact cfr_reference string and full hierarchy, corrective_action text, error_corrected and error_occurred dates, fr_citation, position, display_in_toc, year, last_modified. The errata trail on federal regulation.

name: Federal Register — document detail record
description: The full FR document behind a document_number: abstract, action, agencies[], body_html_url, cfr_references, comments_close_on, dates, docket_ids[], document_number, effective_on, excerpts, full_text_xml_url, html_url, json_url, page ranges, pdf_url, president, publication_date, raw_text_url, regulation_id_numbers (RINs), regulations_dot_gov_info, significant, signing_date, subtype, title, topics[], type. The tree has the LIST endpoint but not this detail hop.

name: Federal Register — documents filtered by agency docket id
description: Pulls every FR notice/rule filed under a specific agency docket number, optionally narrowed by document type. Returns title, type, publication_date, document_number, html_url, abstract. The bridge between a Regulations.gov docket and its Federal Register publications.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Federal Register — documents affecting a CFR part
description: Every FR document that amends a given CFR title/part (count 1,532 for 40 CFR 63). Gives the rulemaking history of a specific regulation, with next_page_url cursor. Joins directly to the eCFR endpoints above.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Federal Register — presidential documents / executive orders
description: Executive orders, proclamations, memoranda and notices (count 1,556 EOs). Each row: title, executive_order_number, signing_date, publication_date, president, document_number, html_url, pdf_url, disposition_notes. Swap presidential_document_type for proclamation/memorandum/notice/determination.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Federal Register — public inspection documents by date
description: Documents on public inspection on a given day — 24 to 72 hours BEFORE they publish (88 rows for one date). agencies[], title, type, document_number, filed_at, publication_date, pdf_url, html_url, raw_text_url, docket_numbers. The early-warning feed; the tree only has /current.json.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Federal Register — public inspection document detail
description: One on-deposit document: agencies[] with raw_name/name/id/url/json_url, document_number, editorial_note, filed_at, filing_type, html_url, pdf_url, publication_date, raw_text_url, title, toc_subject, type. Detail hop from the public-inspection list.

name: Federal Register — curated search definitions
description: FR's own editor-curated topic searches per section (environment, money, world, science-and-technology, business-and-industry, health-and-public-welfare): slug, title, description and the exact search conditions to replay. Ready-made high-signal queries.

name: congress-legislators — current committees and subcommittees
description: 230 committees/subcommittees: type (house/senate/joint), name, url, minority_url, thomas_id, house_committee_id / senate_committee_id, jurisdiction, address, phone, rss_url, and nested subcommittees[]. Keyed by thomas_id to the membership file.

name: congress-legislators — committee membership roster
description: Keyed by committee code (SSAF, HSAG, ...) to an array of members: name, party (majority/minority), rank, title (Chairman/Ranking Member) and bioguide id. Committee -> people and people -> committee in one file.

name: US Department of Justice — blog/official statements API
description: 3,334 DOJ blog posts and official statements with title, body, date, author component, topic[] and url. Policy-level companion to the press-release feed.

name: US Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit — opinions/orders feed
description: 100 items: precedential and nonprecedential Federal Circuit opinions and orders with title (case name + appeal number), link to the PDF, dc:creator, pubDate and content. The appellate court for all US patent, trade and government-contract appeals.

name: US Courts (AO) — judiciary news feed
description: Administrative Office of the US Courts news feed: title, link, description, dc:date. Low volume; carries judicial-vacancy, caseload-statistics and policy announcements for the federal judiciary.

name: PACER RSS — US District Court, N.D. New York
description: Live CM/ECF docket entries. Each item: title = case number + full case caption (e.g. '3:19-cv-04250 Rice v. City and County of San Francisco'), link = DktRpt.pl?{pacer_caseid}, description = the docket-entry type in brackets plus an <a href> to the actual document at /doc1/{docid}?caseid=&de_seq_num=, guid = caseid+sequence, pubDate. Filing-level federal litigation intelligence. This district is NOT among the ~38 already in the tree.

name: PACER RSS — US Bankruptcy Court, S.D. New York

No bankruptcy court is currently in the tree — only district courts.

name: Legistar — Seattle City Council legislation (matters)
description: Granicus Legistar municipal-legislature API, keyless, OData-queryable ($top/$skip/$filter/$orderby). Each matter: MatterId, MatterGuid, MatterFile (e.g. 'CB 121253'), MatterName, MatterTitle (the full ordinance text summary), MatterTypeName, MatterStatusName, MatterBodyId/Name, MatterIntroDate, MatterAgendaDate, MatterPassedDate, MatterEnactmentDate, MatterEnactmentNumber, MatterRequester, MatterNotes, MatterVersion, MatterLastModifiedUtc. MatterId opens four verified sub-resources (sponsors, histories, attachments, versions).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Legistar — sponsors behind a matter
description: Who put the legislation forward: MatterSponsorId, MatterSponsorGuid, MatterSponsorMatterId, MatterSponsorMatterVersion, MatterSponsorNameId (the person id), MatterSponsorBodyId, MatterSponsorName, MatterSponsorSequence, MatterSponsorLastModifiedUtc. Legislation -> people hop.

name: Legistar — action history of a matter (with votes)
description: Every procedural action on a municipal bill: MatterHistoryId, MatterHistoryEventId (links to the meeting), MatterHistoryActionDate, MatterHistoryActionName, MatterHistoryActionText, MatterHistoryPassedFlag, MatterHistoryAgendaSequence/MinutesSequence, MatterHistoryVoteId, MatterHistoryTally and MatterHistoryMoverId/SeconderId. Bill -> committee action -> named vote.

name: Legistar — documents attached to a matter
description: The actual filed documents: MatterAttachmentId, MatterAttachmentName (e.g. 'Att A – CIP Project Additions'), MatterAttachmentHyperlink (direct download on legistar2.granicus.com), MatterAttachmentFileName, MatterAttachmentBinary flag, MatterAttachmentIsSupportingDocument, MatterAttachmentShowOnInternetPage, MatterAttachmentLastModifiedUtc. Terminal document hop.

name: Legistar — amendment versions of a matter
description: Key/Value pairs mapping each internal text id to its version number ([{"Key":"18624","Value":"1"},...]), letting you retrieve every successive draft of an ordinance and diff what changed between readings.

name: Legistar — council members and filers
description: Person registry for the jurisdiction: PersonId, PersonGuid, PersonFirstName/LastName/FullName, PersonActiveFlag, PersonCanViewFlag, PersonEmail, PersonWWW, PersonPhone, PersonAddress1/City1/State1/Zip1, PersonLastModifiedUtc. PersonId joins to MatterSponsorNameId and to vote records.

name: Legistar — council/committee meetings
description: Meetings: EventId, EventGuid, EventBodyId, EventBodyName (e.g. 'Parks, Seattle Center, Libraries, and Gender Pay Equity Committee'), EventDate, EventTime, EventLocation, EventAgendaFile, EventMinutesFile, EventVideoPath, EventInSiteURL, EventLastModifiedUtc. EventId opens the agenda-item hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Legistar — agenda items inside a meeting

Verified meeting -> item -> matter hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Legistar — legislative bodies and committees
