name: Norway Brreg sub-unit (establishment) detail record
description: Full record for a single Norwegian establishment/branch (underenhet): name, complete historiskeNavn array with fraDato/tilDato, organisasjonsform, beliggenhetsadresse and postadresse, kommune, naeringskode, antallAnsatte, registration and deletion dates, and overordnetEnhet pointing back at the parent company. This is the detail hop behind /api/underenheter?overordnetEnhet=.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia RPO — Register of Legal Entities (name search)
description: Keyless JSON search over the Slovak Register právnických osôb. Every hit is already a rich record: internal id, identifiers (ICO with validFrom), full name history with validFrom/validTo, address history, legalForms, establishment/termination dates, sourceRegister (Obchodný register / Živnostenský register), legalStatuses (e.g. 'Zaniknutá spoločnosť'), and empty-or-populated statutoryBodies and stakeholders arrays. The `id` is the key to the entity detail hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia RPO — lookup by IČO
description: Same RPO record set but pivoted on the 8-digit IČO instead of a name, so a company number from any other Slovak source resolves straight to the full name history (e.g. SLOVTEL GSM → GLOBTEL GSM → Globtel → Orange Slovensko), address history, legal form and statutory bodies. The direct entity-number entry point into the Slovak register.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia Register účtovných závierok — statement form + attachments
description: Deepest level of the Slovak chain: the individual accounting form, with idUctovnejZavierky back-link, idSablony (template), kodDanovehoUradu (tax office code), pristupnostDat, and prilohy[] — the actual documents with id, filename, byte size, page count, language, mimeType and a SHA-256 digest for integrity checking.

name: Slovakia Register účtovných závierok — annual report detail
description: Annual report record: idUJ back-link, obdobieOd/obdobieDo, datumZostaveniaK, datumPodania, typ (Individuálna/Konsolidovaná výročná správa), pristupnostDat, and prilohy[] with the real PDF filenames, byte sizes, language and SHA-256 digests.

name: Poland VAT White List — reverse lookup by bank account
description: Reverse pivot: give a 26-digit Polish bank account number and get every taxpayer that has declared it — name, NIP, REGON, KRS, statusVat, addresses, representatives, partners. An account-number-to-company resolver, which is rare and very high value for tracing payments.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Poland VAT White List — batch NIP lookup
description: Batch form of the white list: comma-separated NIPs in one request, response grouped as entries[].identifier + entries[].subjects[] with the same full payload (name, statusVat, regon, krs, addresses, representatives, partners, accountNumbers). Lets you resolve a whole list of Polish counterparties in a single request.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Spain BDNS — granting-body hierarchy codelist
description: Tree of Spanish granting authorities (ministries → directorates-general → agencies) with descripcion, id and nested children[]. idAdmon selects the administration level (C central, A autonomic, L local). Needed to filter the award tables by authority and to resolve the nivel1/nivel2/nivel3 strings.

name: EU VIES VAT validation REST API (all member states)
description: Keyless REST replacement for the old VIES SOAP service. Path is /ms/{2-letter member state}/vat/{vat number}. Returns isValid, userError (VALID/INVALID/MS_UNAVAILABLE), and the officially registered name and address as held by that member state's tax administration — verified live for DK (GOOGLE DENMARK ApS), FR (SA SODIMAS), SE (SAAB AKTIEBOLAG), PL (ORANGE POLSKA SA), IE (GOOGLE IRELAND LIMITED). Also returns a viesApproximate block with per-field match scores. One EU-wide entity resolver for any VAT number.

name: ESMA registers — raw Solr, upreg core (101,959 docs)
description: The raw Solr index behind the ESMA register UI, far deeper than the searchRegister HTML endpoint already in the tree. Parent docs are entities (ae_entityName, ae_entityTypeCode MIF/CI/…, ae_lei, ae_headOfficeLei, ae_officeType Branch/Head office, ae_competentAuthority, ae_lastUpdate); child docs (type_s:child, _root_) are the individual authorised activities/services (ac_serviceName, ac_authorisationNotificationDateStr, ac_status). Supports full Solr syntax, e.g. q=ae_entityName:*Deutsche* → 46 hits.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ESMA — national securities-regulator sanctions register (1,378 docs)
description: Every sanction imposed by an EU national competent authority under MiFID/MAR/UCITS/AIFMD etc.: sn_entityName (with an embedded href to the entity's upreg detail page), sn_entityEsmaID, sn_sanctionLegalFrameworkName, sn_date, sn_ncaCodeFullName + sn_sanctioningNCACode (e.g. CZ_CNB Czech National Bank), sn_countryName, sn_nature/sn_natureFullName (ADSM administrative sanction and measure). The enforcement-actions layer sitting on top of the ESMA entity register.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ESMA — MiFID share trading obligation / exemptions core (162,834 docs)
description: Instrument-level register: shs_isin, shs_name (issuer), shs_countryCode, shs_relevantAuthority (e.g. 'Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (BaFin)'), shs_status, shs_exemptionStartDateStr, shs_modificationDateStr. 162k rows mapping ISINs to issuers and their supervising national authority — useful for resolving a security back to a regulated issuer and its home regulator.

name: ESMA FIRDS file index (18,480 docs)
description: Index of the Financial Instruments Reference Data System delivery files — the bulk reference dataset covering every MiFIR-reportable instrument in the EU. Each doc points at a downloadable full/delta file with its publication date and checksum, which is the entry point to the complete EU instrument-to-issuer reference data.

name: Germany Marktstammdatenregister — electricity generation units + operators
description: Keyless Kendo-grid JSON over the German energy master data register. Per unit: Id, MaStRNummer (SEE…), AnlagenbetreiberId + AnlagenbetreiberMaStRNummer (ABR…) + AnlagenbetreiberName — i.e. the legal operator behind each asset — BetriebsStatusName, EinheitName, InbetriebnahmeDatum, EinheitMeldeDatum, Ort, Plz, Flurstueck (land parcel), Bruttoleistung, EnergietraegerName. The AnlagenbetreiberId is a stable operator key that links every asset owned by the same company. NOTE: the `filter=` parameter is mandatory — omitting it returns {"Error":true}.

name: Denmark ERST — filed annual reports Elasticsearch (6,422,525 filings)
description: Open, unauthenticated Elasticsearch endpoint over every annual report filed in Denmark: 6,422,525 hits total, 20 for one CVR. Each _source has cvrNummer, sagsNummer, regnskab.regnskabsperiode.startDato/slutDato, sidstOpdateret and dokumenter[] with dokumentType (AARSRAPPORT), dokumentMimeType and dokumentUrl pointing at the actual PDF and machine-readable XBRL. Supports both q= Lucene syntax and full POST DSL. NOTE: HTTP only, no TLS.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Rechtspraak Open Data - uitspraken changed-since feed
description: Atom feed of Dutch court rulings filtered by last-modified date (incremental harvest). Each entry: ECLI as <id>, court name, decision date, case number, plain-text summary, updated timestamp, alternate HTML link. The ECLI feeds the content detail hop which returns the ENTIRE ruling: RDF metadata block (court, jurisdiction, procedure type, subject area, references to legislation and cited case law) plus the full section-by-section judgment text.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SAOS - full judgment bulk dump
description: Bulk pagination over every SAOS judgment with the complete record inline (~50 KB/page for 10): full text, judges + roles, legal bases, referenced regulations, court chamber/division ids, source URL and publication date. This is the exhaustive harvest path, no per-record second request needed.

name: SAOS - Polish common courts registry
description: Court entities with id, name, court type/level, parent court and the nested list of divisions (each with its own id, name and type). Resolves the court/division ids that appear on every judgment record.

name: SAOS - Supreme Court chambers and divisions
description: Polish Supreme Court chambers (Izba Karna, Cywilna, etc.) each with id, name and nested divisions - 21 id/name pairs total. Decodes the chamber references on Supreme Court judgments.

name: entscheidsuche.ch - all Swiss court decisions (Elasticsearch proxy)
description: Open Elasticsearch proxy over 53 shards covering federal and all cantonal Swiss courts; 10,000+ hits on a single keyword. Each hit's _source gives: date, court hierarchy array (canton/court/collection), multilingual abstract (de/fr/it), multilingual title, reference/keywords array, source id, AND an attachment object containing content_type, language, the decision PDF content_url and - critically - the ENTIRE extracted PDF text inline. One request yields both the index row and the full decision body; the content_url is the verified PDF detail hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Gesetze im Internet - full TOC of German federal legislation
description: 6,127 German federal statutes and ordinances: short title, full title, and link to the per-law XML/ZIP. The norm layer that the federal case-law corpus above cites.

name: Open Legal Data DE - single case full record
description: Detail hop for the 423,944-case German corpus (the bare list endpoint is already in the tree; this per-id record is not). Returns id, slug, nested court object (id, name, slug, city, state, jurisdiction, level_of_appeal), file_number, decision date, created/updated timestamps, decision type (Urteil/Beschluss/Endurteil), ECLI, source_url and the full decision CONTENT field.

name: Open Legal Data DE - court registry
description: German court entities with id, name, slug, city id, federal state id, jurisdiction branch (Ordentliche/Verwaltungs/Finanz/Arbeits/Sozial-gerichtsbarkeit) and level_of_appeal. Resolves the court ids on every case record and lets you enumerate cases per court.

name: ESMA registers - raw Solr core: investment firms register
description: 101,959 documents. Raw Solr behind the ESMA MiFID investment-firm register (the tree only has the HTML searchRegister wrapper). Parent docs are authorised entities; child docs (entity_type=aeActivity, type_s=child, _root_ pointing at the parent) are the individual authorised services with authorisation/notification dates, end dates and status - i.e. the firm-to-permission detail hop is inside the same index via _root_.

name: ESMA registers - raw Solr core: benchmark administrators
description: 28,134 documents. Benchmark Regulation register entities with ESMA id, full legal name, LEI, country, SUPERVISING NATIONAL AUTHORITY (e.g. BaFin - DEBA), EU/EEA relevant authority, EU/EEA status and registration article, and contact URL. Direct LEI-keyed link from a company to its EU supervisor.

name: ESMA FIRDS - reference-data file index
description: 18,480 published FIRDS instrument-reference files: publication id, file name (FULINS/DLTINS type, date, part-of-N), file type, publication date and download link. The index you page through to bulk-harvest EU instrument reference data.

name: ESMA FIRDS - instrument reference data (raw Solr)
description: 276,183,161 documents. Per instrument: ISIN, MIC of the trading venue, issuer LEI, full instrument name, CFI code, commodity-derivative flag, relevant competent authority, validity from/to dates and the underlying issuer ISIN. Pivot from an ISIN or an issuer LEI to every EU venue the instrument trades on and its supervising authority.

name: Slovakia RPVS - public-sector partners with parent entity expanded
description: Slovak Register of Public Sector Partners (mandatory beneficial-ownership register for anyone taking public money). This $expand form returns each registered partner - person name/surname/date of birth or company ObchodneMeno + ICO, legal-person flag, validity from/to - together with its parent Partner record. The tree has the bare list; the expand form and the id detail hop below are the deep path.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Slovakia RPVS - qualified complaints / enforcement proceedings
description: Enforcement proceedings opened against registered partners for false beneficial-ownership declarations: proceeding id, date proceedings started, date ended, date the decision became final, decision-outcome code, and the COURT FILE NUMBER (SpisovaZnackaKonania, e.g. 43PExre/1/2017). This is the sanction layer of the register - the record that says a partner was investigated and struck off.

name: Slovakia RPVS - OData service document
description: Lists the seven entity sets of the register: Partneri, PartneriVerejnehoSektora, OpravneneOsoby (authorised verifying persons), KonecniUzivateliaVyhod (ULTIMATE BENEFICIAL OWNERS), VerejniFunkcionari (public officials among the owners), VerifikacneDokumenty (verification documents), KvalifikovanePodnety. Needed to drive $expand and $filter correctly - note there is no PartnerId property, traversal must go through Partneri({id})?$expand=.

name: GOV.UK Search API - CMA competition and merger cases
description: 2,573 Competition and Markets Authority cases (mergers, cartels, market investigations, consumer enforcement). Per row: title naming the parties, link, description of the transaction/conduct, case_type, case_state (open/closed), opened_date, closed_date, market_sector. Detail hop via the GOV.UK Content API returns the full case page including every published document (decision notices, provisional findings, undertakings, penalty notices) with dates and file URLs. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - Employment Tribunal decisions
description: Employment Tribunal judgments, title carries claimant v respondent employer and case number (e.g. 2600557/2024), plus decision categories and decision date. Detail hop via the Content API yields the full decision page with the downloadable judgment documents. Names employers found liable for discrimination, unfair dismissal, whistleblowing detriment. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - Upper Tribunal (Administrative Appeals) decisions
description: Upper Tribunal AAC decisions with neutral citation ([2026] UKUT 276 (AAC)), parties, subject categories, decision date and the judges. Content API detail hop returns the full decision document. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - Tax and Chancery Tribunal decisions
description: Upper Tribunal Tax and Chancery decisions - HMRC v taxpayer, financial-services regulatory references, VAT and avoidance-scheme litigation. Neutral citation, parties, category and decision date; Content API detail hop returns the full judgment. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - MHRA medical device / drug safety alerts
description: MHRA device safety information and national patient safety alerts, e.g. devices supplied without valid UKCA/CE conformity marking ordered removed from use. Per row: title with alert reference (DSI/2026/007), alert_type, issued_date, medical specialism. Content API detail hop returns the full alert naming the manufacturer, affected models and required action. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - Rail Accident Investigation Branch reports
description: RAIB investigation reports: report number, incident description, date_of_occurrence, railway type. Content API detail hop returns the full report page with the PDF, findings, causal factors and safety recommendations addressed to named operators and infrastructure managers. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - Marine Accident Investigation Branch reports
description: MAIB reports naming the vessel and its registration (e.g. fishing vessel Silver Cloud II WK 80), date_of_occurrence and vessel type. Content API detail hop returns the full investigation report with owner/operator, causal analysis and recommendations. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GOV.UK Search API - MHRA Drug Safety Update
description: MHRA monthly drug safety bulletins - product-level warnings, restrictions and label changes (e.g. botulinum toxin type A iatrogenic botulism warning). Title, link, summary, first_published_at; Content API detail hop returns the full article with the affected products and the regulatory action taken. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Find Case Law (TNA) - judgment feed with Akoma Ntoso XML detail hop
description: National Archives Find Case Law, 8,124 pages of judgments. Each entry: document id (d-uuid), case name, court, date, and alternate links to the HTML page, the PDF on assets.caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk, and - the part the tree does not have - the /data.xml Akoma Ntoso representation. That XML carries structured FRBR metadata, neutral citation, court, judges, PARTIES and their counsel, and the fully marked-up judgment body with numbered paragraphs. NOTE: country should read GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Retsinformation Denmark - legal document search API
description: Keyless JSON search over the Danish official legal information system; this filter (dt=10, Acts) returns 2,472 documents across 248 pages. Per document: numeric id, shortName (LOV nr 1618 af 16/12/2025), full title, popular title, RESSORT MINISTRY, document type + ELI type code, ELI retsinfoLink (/eli/lta/2025/1618), classification id, publication date and history flag. Changing dt selects other document types (ordinances, circulars, administrative guidance). I could not find a JSON detail endpoint - the /eli/ page is a client-rendered shell - so no detail hop is claimed.

name: Diavgeia (Greece) — government decision search
description: Every published act of every Greek public body, including expenditure approvals, procurement awards and payment orders. Each row gives the ADA (unique decision id), protocol number, full Greek subject line, decision type, issuing organisation and unit, signer, and thematic categories. Queryable by organizationUid, decision type, date and free text — this is the single deepest 'who was paid by whom' feed in Greece.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Diavgeia — official position register
description: 25,134 official post titles (uid + Greek label: Deputy Minister, Director-General, Special Secretary, ...) used to resolve the signer of an expenditure or award decision to a role. 1.6 MB.

name: Diavgeia — controlled-vocabulary index
description: Index of the 19 reference dictionaries Diavgeia records reference (CPV, CURRENCY, ADMIN_STRUCTURE_KALLIKRATIS administrative geography, and 16 more), each with uid and label. Each uid dereferences to the full vocabulary.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Diavgeia — CPV code vocabulary (Greek)
description: The complete 10,357-entry CPV procurement classification with Greek labels and parent codes, as used to tag Greek award decisions. 1.2 MB. Lets a CPV filter be applied to Diavgeia decisions and cross-walked to TED.

name: BDNS Spain — NUTS region tree
description: Nested NUTS geography used to filter Spanish grant data (ES11 GALICIA -> ES111 A Coruña, ES112 Lugo, ...) with the internal numeric ids the search API expects.

name: BDNS Spain — policy-purpose codes
description: 21 policy purposes a Spanish subsidy can be classified under (housing, agriculture/fisheries/food, trade/tourism/SMEs, international cooperation, culture...) with ids, used to slice grant spending by policy area.

name: BDNS Spain — aid instrument codes
description: The six aid instruments (outright grant, loan, guarantee, tax advantage, risk-finance contribution, other) with ids. Distinguishes cash transfers from contingent liabilities in the concession rows.

name: BDNS Spain — beneficiary economic-activity codes
description: 22 NACE-style economic activity sectors (agriculture/livestock/forestry/fishing, extractive industries, manufacturing, electricity supply...) with ids, used to filter grant beneficiaries by industry.

name: BDNS Spain — State aid regulation codes
description: The nine EU legal bases under which Spanish aid is granted (no regulation/prior notification, General Block Exemption REG 651/2014, primary agricultural production REG 2022/2472, ...) with ids — the legal-basis filter for state-aid and de minimis queries.

name: BDNS Spain — State aid objective codes
description: 185 GBER article-level aid objectives ('ART. 13 innovation aid', 'ART. 14 investment in agricultural holdings', ...) with ids. The finest-grained legal classifier available on a Spanish aid award.

name: BDNS Spain — agricultural product-sector codes
description: 24 CMO product sectors (cereals part I, rice part II, sugar part III, dried fodder part IV, ...) with ids, used to classify CAP-adjacent Spanish aid awards by commodity.

name: eZamówienia / BZP (Poland) — public notice board search
description: Poland's Biuletyn Zamowien Publicznych. Undocumented but keyless; I recovered the gateway from /mo-board/api/v1/Config (apiUrlQuery=/mo-board/api). Each row: noticeType, BZP notice number (2024/BZP 00104588/01), publication date, full order description, multi-line CPV list with Polish labels, offer-submission deadline, procedure result, buying organisation name/city/NUTS province/country, organizationNationalId (the Polish NIP — a hard join key to company data), organizationId, OCDS tenderId (ocds-148610-...), a contractors field, and objectId.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Kohesio (EU) — cohesion-fund beneficiary list
description: Who actually receives EU cohesion money: beneficiary label (e.g. GENERALNA DYREKCJA DROG KRAJOWYCH I AUTOSTRAD), linkedopendata.eu entity id, country and country code, total budget, EU budget share, co-financing rate, and the number of projects that beneficiary holds. Ranked by size, so it is a direct top-recipient league table across all member states.

name: CORDIS (EU) — research project search
description: 58,915 EU-funded research projects. Rows give grant agreement reference/id, acronym, title, framework programme with code and rcn, start/end dates, coordinating country, objective teaser and last-update date. The tree had the cordis host but not this search API. Supports arbitrary field queries (e.g. AND /project/rcn=193159) so it doubles as a lookup.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CORDIS (EU) — research result/deliverable search
description: 884,143 research outputs (deliverables, publications, reports) produced under EU grants, each linkable back to the funding project. Same query grammar and pagination (searchAfter cursor) as the project search.

name: CORDIS (EU) — funding programme hierarchy
description: 8,678 EU funding programme/sub-programme nodes (FP7, H2020, Horizon Europe, Euratom branches) with codes and rcns — the budget-line tree that every CORDIS project attaches to.

name: European Investment Bank — financed project list
description: Every EIB loan/financing operation back to 1959. Rows give project id, description of the works financed, status and signature date plus signed and disbursed amounts in additionalInformation, and primaryTags carrying the country (label + ISO code) and sector (label + code). The url field is the numeric project id used for the detail page.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ProZorro (Ukraine) — tender change feed
description: Chronological change feed of every Ukrainian public tender (id + dateModified, cursor-paginated) on the production public API host — distinct from the public.api.openprocurement.org sandbox host already in the tree. Each id dereferences to the full OCDS-style tender: procurement method, tender period, description, items with DK021 classification, value, procuring entity with its EDRPOU code, and the full document set.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ProZorro — awards under a tender
description: The award hop: for a given tender, the qualification decisions naming the winning supplier, award status, value, and the signed award documents with direct public.docs.openprocurement.org download URLs. This is where 'notice' becomes 'contractor'.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ProZorro — bids submitted to a tender
description: 12.4 KB of the actual bids on a tender: bidder identity, bid status, offered value, and every submitted PDF with a working document URL. Losing bidders are exposed too, which is what makes collusion and single-bid patterns detectable.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ProZorro — contracts signed under a tender
description: Contracts concluded from a tender: status, itemised deliverables with descriptions and quantities, contract value and period, and the link back to the award.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ProZorro — clarification questions on a tender
description: The clarification thread on a tender: each question's author, text, date asked and the buyer's answer. Tailored-specification complaints surface here before any formal challenge exists.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ProZorro — contract change feed
description: Feed of all Ukrainian public contracts by id + dateModified. Dereferencing an id returns a 24.7 KB record with awardID, tender_id (back-pointer to the originating tender), itemised scope, value, contract period, supplier identity and the signed documents.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ProZorro — procurement plans feed
description: Pre-tender procurement plans (id + dateModified). Plans reveal intended purchases and budgets before any notice is published, which is where budget-to-award divergence is measurable.

name: ProZorro — framework agreements feed
description: Framework agreements (id + dateModified) — the multi-supplier vehicles that later call-offs are drawn against.

name: ProZorro — qualification frameworks feed
description: Dynamic purchasing / qualification frameworks (id + dateModified), the register of pre-qualified suppliers admitted to restricted procurement channels.

name: Web NDL Authorities - person/corporate name authority record (JSON-LD)
description: Authority record for a named person or organisation: uri, primaryTopic with foaf:Person/foaf:Organization type, prefLabel literalForm plus transcription (kana reading), altLabel variant names and pseudonyms, birth/death dates, related authorities (owl:sameAs to VIAF/LCNAME), source citations and created/modified timestamps. The entity-resolution layer for Japanese personal and corporate names in library data.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Web NDL Authorities - subject heading (NDLSH) record
description: NDL subject heading as SKOS Concept: uri, prefLabel literalForm with kana transcription, altLabel synonyms, broader/narrower/related concept links, created (back to 1980) and modified dates. Lets you expand or normalise a topic before running an NDL Search query.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NDL Lab Next Digital Library - full-text book search
description: Full-text OCR search across NDL Digital Collections public-domain books. 5,426 hits for one keyword; each row carries id (NDL pid), version, title, volume, responsibility statement, publisher, published/publishyear, NDC class, bibId, callNo, leftopen flag, autoTOCFlag and an index array of OCR'd table-of-contents entries with .jp2 page anchors. Also returns an isClassic facet.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NDL Digital Collections - IIIF Presentation manifest
description: IIIF 2.x manifest for a digitised NDL item: label, metadata array (Persistent ID info:ndljp/pid/NNNN, Title, Creator, Publisher, Date, call number, rights), attribution, license, and the sequence of canvases with per-page image service URLs. Turns any NDL pid seen in a search result into page-level scanned imagery.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NDL Diet Minutes API - full meeting record (all speeches)
description: The verbatim-transcript endpoint, distinct from meeting_list and speech already in the tree. Each meetingRecord gives issueID, imageKind, session, nameOfHouse, nameOfMeeting, issue number, date, closing flag, plus a speechRecord array - here 18 speeches in one sitting - with speechID, speechOrder, speaker name, speakerYomi, speakerGroup (party), speakerPosition, speakerRole and the complete speech text. numberOfRecords was 321 sittings. This is the deepest hop into Japanese parliamentary proceedings: bill -> sitting -> named speaker -> full text.

name: GSI landform classification vector tiles (disaster-risk terrain)
description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of classified landform polygons (natural levee, back marsh, reclaimed land, artificial fill, terrace...) per XYZ tile. This is the layer behind Japan's 'land condition / disaster-risk terrain' maps - it tells you whether a given address sits on liquefaction-prone fill. Keyless, tile-addressed so it can be swept over any bbox.

name: MOE Soramame - national monitoring station instrument register
description: Per-page instrument inventory for the MOE-operated (kokusetsu) monitoring stations: for each measured item, the pollutant name (SO2, NOx, ...), the analytical method used (e.g. ultraviolet fluorescence) and the intake height in metres. Methodological metadata you need to compare readings across stations.

name: MOE Soramame - prefecture / region code master
description: All 47 prefectures as {code, name, area} where area is the Soramame regional grouping id. The join table between Soramame's per-prefecture station files (already in the tree) and its regional aggregates.

name: MOE Soramame - ambiguous station-name disambiguation table
description: Entity-resolution table for monitoring stations whose names collide: each entry gives code, name, pref and a duplicate array of the other station codes sharing that name. Essential to avoid mismatching readings when joining Soramame data by station name rather than code.

name: PeeringDB organisations (list)
description: Every network/facility/IX owning organisation: id, legal name, aka, website, social_media handles, street address + city/state/zip/country, lat/lon, created/updated timestamps. This is the root of the PeeringDB ownership tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: PeeringDB facility detail (depth=2)
description: One datacentre: name, aka, CLLI, NPA-NXX, address, lat/lon, region, available_voltage_services, diverse_serving_substations, property owner, net_count/ix_count/carrier_count, and the parent org object inlined with its full fac_set/net_set id lists.

name: PeeringDB internet exchange detail (depth=2)
description: One IX (AMS-IX): operating org inlined, media type, protocols, policy/tech/sales contacts, net_count, and inlined ixlan_set / fac_set.

name: PeeringDB IX port memberships (netixlan)
description: Per-port membership rows joining a network to an exchange LAN: net_id, ix_id, ixlan_id, asn, ipaddr4, ipaddr6, port speed (Mbit), is_rs_peer, bfd_support, operational flag. The IX -> member-ASN -> peering IP hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: PeeringDB facility presence (netfac)
description: Which ASNs are physically present in a given datacentre: net_id, fac_id, local_asn, facility name/city/country. Facility -> tenant network hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: PeeringDB IX LAN
description: The LAN under an exchange: mtu, dot1q_support, route-server ASN, arp_sponge, and the ixf_ixp_member_list_url (the exchange's own machine-readable member list, a further hop off-site).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: PeeringDB IX peering prefixes
description: The IPv4/IPv6 prefixes assigned to an exchange LAN, with in_dfz flag and created/updated dates. Turns an observed peering IP into a named exchange.

name: PeeringDB IX-to-facility links
description: Which datacentres an exchange has switches in: ix_id, fac_id, facility name, city, country. IX -> physical building hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: PeeringDB carrier detail (depth=2)
description: One carrier with its owning org object inlined (legal address, lat/lon, all *_set id lists) and its facility footprint.

name: PeeringDB carrier facility presence
description: Which datacentres a carrier fabric reaches: carrier_id, fac_id, facility name, created/updated. Carrier -> building hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: PeeringDB campuses
description: Multi-building datacentre campuses: id, org_id, org_name, name, aka, website, social_media, country/city/state/zipcode.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: PeeringDB campus detail (depth=2)
description: One campus with owning org inlined including net_set/fac_set/ix_set id lists and the org's free-text notes (which often name the merged operators behind the campus).

name: PeeringDB facilities by country, depth=1
description: Facilities in a country with org fields already expanded one level: org_name, campus_id, CLLI/rencode/npanxx, sales and tech contact email/phone, available_voltage_services, net_count/ix_count/carrier_count. Different from the depth=0 country listing already in the tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ARIN RDAP entity (org) with autnums + networks
description: RDAP entity for an org handle: full autnums[] array (each with handle, start/endAutnum, name, events for registration and last-changed) and networks[], plus nested entities with vCard contact blocks. 95 KB for GOGL.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ARIN RDAP autnum
description: ASN RDAP object: start/endAutnum, name, status, events, and nested entities carrying abuse/tech/admin POC handles with vCard (org, address, phone, email) and links back to whois.arin.net.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: RIPE Atlas probe detail
description: One measurement probe: public IPv4/IPv6 address, asn_v4/asn_v6, announced prefix_v4/prefix_v6, country, description, firmware version, first_connected/last_connected epochs, status history, geometry point, and tags. Tree only had the probe list.

name: IIJ Internet Health Report network lookup
description: Resolves an AS number to IHR's canonical network name plus flags for which IHR datasets exist for it (hegemony, delay_forwarding, disco). The index hop before the heavier IHR calls.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IIJ IHR country-level AS hegemony
description: For a country, every transit AS ranked by hegemony score (dependency weight) with timebin, asn, asn_name, weight, weightscheme, transitonly flag. 1,488 rows for JP. Shows which foreign carriers a national internet depends on.

name: OONI measurements list (country filtered)
description: Measurement rows with anomaly/confirmed/failure flags, input URL, probe_asn, probe_cc, report_id, blocking scores (general/global/country/isp/local) and, critically, measurement_url — the raw_measurement link used as the detail hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OONI test-name registry
description: Canonical id/name pairs for every OONI test (bridge_reachability, dnscheck, psiphon, riseupvpn, whatsapp, ...). Needed to enumerate the measurements API exhaustively per test.

name: OpenStreetMap way with all member nodes
description: A way plus every node it references, each with lat/lon, timestamp, version, changeset id, editing user name and uid. Turns one feature id into its full geometry and its complete edit provenance.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenStreetMap relation with all members
description: A relation (e.g. an administrative boundary) recursively expanded into every member way and node with coordinates, versions, changesets and editor identities. 44 KB for the Manchester boundary.

name: OpenStreetMap element version history
description: Every historical version of one element: version number, timestamp, changeset id, user and uid, and the complete tag set as it stood at that version. Shows who changed what about a feature and when.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenStreetMap relations containing an element
description: Every relation a node/way belongs to, with the relation's full member list, roles, tags, version, changeset and last editor. Upward hop from a point to the boundaries, routes and networks it is part of.

name: OpenStreetMap changeset with discussion
description: One changeset: created_at/closed_at, open flag, changes_count split into created/modified/deleted, bbox, uid and user, tags (comment, created_by editor + version, host, imagery_used, locale) and the full comment thread with commenter uid, name and date.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenStreetMap changesets by user id
description: An individual mapper's edit stream: changeset id, created_at/closed_at, counts, bbox (min/max lat/lon — i.e. where they were editing), and tags naming the editor software, host and imagery used. Tree had bbox and display_name queries but not the uid query.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenStreetMap raw map extract by bbox
description: Every node, way and relation inside a bounding box with full tags plus per-element version, timestamp, changeset, user and uid. 600 KB for a 1 km square — a full local feature inventory with edit provenance, without touching Overpass.

name: Nominatim structured address search
description: Field-by-field address query (street/city/county/state/postalcode/country) returning place_id, osm_type+osm_id, lat/lon, category/type, addresstype, parsed address components with ISO3166-2, extratags (height, building:levels, architect, operator, old descriptions) and namedetails in every language.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Nominatim place details
description: Deepest Nominatim record: place_id and parent_place_id, all names including old_name, addresstags, calculated_postcode, indexed_date, importance, rank_address/rank_search, isarea, centroid, geometry, admin hierarchy and linked places. The genuine detail hop behind a search hit.

name: Nominatim batch OSM-id lookup
description: Resolve up to 50 OSM ids at once to place records with address components, extratags (ref:gss, ons_code, wikidata, wikipedia, council_name, admin_level) and multilingual namedetails. Batch hop from OSM ids found elsewhere.

name: OSM taginfo values for a key
description: Ranked distinct values of a key with count, fraction, in_wiki flag and wiki description. For key=operator this is a global census of infrastructure operators (Enedis 1.62 M objects, RTE 345 k, SNCF Réseau 313 k, DB InfraGO 120 k) — a company-to-asset-count index. total=1,318,754 values, fully paginable.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OSM taginfo search by tag value
description: Free-text search across all tag values, returning key, value and count_all for each hit (46 matches for TEPCO across brand, name, name:en, name:ko, addr:suburb). Company name -> every OSM tag spelling that references it, which then drives targeted extraction.

name: TfL line -> all stop points
description: Every stop served by a line: naptanId, stationNaptan, hubNaptanCode, icsCode, stopType, modes, the lines and lineGroups served, lineModeGroups, lat/lon and additionalProperties. Line -> station roster hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: TfL stop point detail
description: One station/interchange: naptanId, hubNaptanCode, stopType, all modes, every line calling there, lineGroup and lineModeGroups, children stops (platforms, entrances, bus stands) and additionalProperties (zone, WiFi, toilets, accessibility).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: TfL live arrivals at a stop
description: Live vehicle predictions: prediction id, vehicleId, lineId/lineName, platformName, direction, bearing, currentLocation free text, towards, timeToStation seconds, expectedArrival, and timing provenance. The deepest live hop off a stop id.

name: TfL line route sequence with geometry
description: Ordered station sequence for a line and direction plus the lineStrings polyline geometry, orderedLineRoutes and per-station stationId/icsId/topMostParentId/zone/lat/lon. Physical route trace, not just a stop list.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: TfL per-line disruption
description: Active disruption records for a single line: category, type, categoryDescription, human description, closureText, and affectedRoutes / affectedStops arrays. Finer than the mode-level Status call already in the tree.

name: TfL stop point name search
description: Name -> stop ids with icsId, modes, fare zone, topMostParentId, lat/lon and total match count. The entry point that makes every other TfL id-based hop reachable from a plain place name.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: TfL car parks (Place API)
description: Every TfL car park as a Place: id, url, commonName, placeType, lat/lon and a long additionalProperties list (SmartParkingLocationCode, address lines, bay counts, charges, opening hours) each with sourceSystemKey and modified timestamp.

name: TfL transport mode registry
description: Every mode name with isTflService, isFarePaying and isScheduledService flags. Needed to enumerate the Line API exhaustively instead of hardcoding tube/bus.

name: TfL all lines with route sections
description: Every line in the network (82 KB) with id, name, modeName, created/modified, lineStatuses and routeSections giving each direction's name, originationName/destinationName, originator and destination Naptan codes and validFrom/validTo. Full network graph in one request.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: VBB (Berlin-Brandenburg) location search
description: Stop name -> stop id with lat/lon, products served (suburban/subway/tram/bus/ferry/express/regional booleans), IFOPT id and stationDHID (the German national stop identifier). Entry hop for the departures API.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Transitous (MOTIS) stop times
description: Departures/arrivals at a stop across the community-run pan-European GTFS aggregation: place with stopId/parentId/lat/lon/level/timezone, scheduled vs realtime arrival and departure, scheduledTrack vs track, pickup/dropoff type, cancelled flag, mode, headsign and tripId. The tree only had the transitous geocode call.

name: Transitous stops in a bounding box
description: All transit stops inside a bbox with stopId, name, lat/lon, level, timezone, free-text description of the physical stop, vertexType and served modes. Geographic entry point into the aggregated feed set.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: MobilityData GBFS systems catalogue
description: The canonical registry of every public bike/scooter share system worldwide: Country Code, Name, Location, System ID, operator URL, Auto-Discovery URL (the gbfs.json to crawl), supported GBFS versions and authentication requirements. 38 KB — this is the seed list that makes exhaustive GBFS collection possible, and it is keyless unlike api.mobilitydatabase.org.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GBFS v3 auto-discovery (PBSC/Careem BIKE)
description: The feed index every GBFS system exposes: named URLs for gbfs_versions, geofencing_zones, station_information, station_status, system_information, system_pricing_plans, vehicle_types. One hop yields the whole per-system dataset list.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Digitraffic Finnish rail operator registry
description: Every licensed rail operator in Finland: id, operatorName, operatorShortCode, operatorUICCode and the train-number ranges allocated to it by trainCategory (Cargo, Locomotive, Shunting, On-track machines). Maps any observed train number to the company running it.

name: Digitraffic Finnish TMS station live sensor data
description: Per-sensor readings from one traffic measurement station: sensor id, name (e.g. OHITUKSET_60MIN_KIINTEA_SUUNTA1 = vehicles/hour by direction), shortName, unit, value, measuredTime and the aggregation window. The detail hop under the station list already in the tree.

name: Digitraffic road maintenance vehicle tracking
description: GeoJSON LineString traces of actual maintenance vehicle movements: tracking id and previousId (chainable), sendingTime, startTime/endTime, created, tasks[] performed (MECHANICAL_CUT, SALTING, PLOUGHING...), direction, domain and source agency. 257 KB — real contractor activity on the road network.

name: Elexon BMRS REMIT message list
description: Index of REMIT inside-information filings (generation unavailability notices): id, mrid, revisionNumber, createdTime, publishTime and a direct url to the full message. Max 7-day window. This is the list half of the highest-value energy disclosure feed in GB.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Elexon BM unit master reference
description: Every balancing mechanism unit in GB (389 KB): nationalGridBmUnit, elexonBmUnit, EIC, fuelType, leadPartyName and leadPartyId (the company legally responsible), bmUnitType, bmUnitName (plant name), demandCapacity, generationCapacity, transmissionLossFactor, credit assessment import/export capabilities, gspGroupId/gspGroupName and interconnectorId. Resolves any BM unit code seen in REMIT/BOALF/PN to its owning company and physical station.

name: Elexon interconnector reference
description: Every GB electricity interconnector with interconnectorId, interconnectorName and the counterparty biddingZone (Eleclink/France, Greenlink/Ireland, Moyle/Northern Ireland, BritNed/Netherlands, NSL/Norway, Viking/Denmark).

name: Elexon disaggregated balancing services adjustment
description: Non-BM balancing actions with cost and volume, soFlag/storFlag, partyId, assetId, isTendered and service name — i.e. which counterparty was paid for what ancillary service in each settlement period.

name: Elering Nord Pool spot price (Baltic)
description: 15-minute Nord Pool day-ahead prices per Baltic bidding area (ee, lv, lt, fi) as timestamp/price pairs. Keyless, no registration, unlike ENTSO-E.

name: openSenseMap box detail
description: One station with each sensor's lastMeasurement resolved inline to value and createdAt, plus sensorType, title and unit. Detail hop off the box registry.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: openSenseMap box sensor list
description: Sensor inventory for a station: sensor _id, boxes_id, sensorType, title, unit and lastMeasurement (value + createdAt). The sensor _id is the key for the time-series hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Safecast radiation measurements
description: Volunteer radiation readings: id, user_id, value, unit (cpm), device_id, devicetype_id, sensor_id, station_id, channel_id, captured_at, height, latitude, longitude, and measurement_import_id linking back to the upload batch.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Safecast measurement detail
description: Single reading with its uploading user_id, device_id, original_id and measurement_import_id — the keys that pivot to the contributor and the drive log.

name: Safecast bGeigie import batches
description: Each uploaded survey drive: import id, user_id, source.url (the raw .LOG file on S3), md5sum, status and status_details, measurements_count, lines_count, approved flag, created/updated, name, description, credits, height, orientation and the cities covered — often in Japanese. Not present in the tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Safecast bGeigie import detail
description: One survey batch with the downloadable raw log URL, checksum, per-stage processing status, 4,147 measurement count, contributor credits and the route description. Links a named volunteer to a geolocated radiation survey.

name: EMODnet offshore hydrocarbon wells
description: Every offshore well in European waters as a point: code, name, country, year, purpose (Exploration/Production), content (Natural Gas/Oil), status (Abandoned/Producing), named operator and company, water depth and distance to coast. Paginable with count/startIndex.

name: EMODnet offshore platforms
description: Offshore installations: platformid, name, country, current_status, category (Fixed steel etc.), function, named operator, location_blocks (licence block ids), primary_production, topside and substructure weights, production_start, valid_from/valid_to, water_depth and remarks.

name: EMODnet subsea pipelines
description: Pipeline routes as MultiLineString with name, status, medium carried, operator, size_in (diameter), length_m, year, from_loc/to_loc endpoints, country code and source agency note.

name: EMODnet coastal nuclear power plants
description: Per-reactor records: site code and name, country, status (Operational / Permanently shut down), reactor count, thermal/gross/net capacity MW, reactor name, reactor type and model, fuel, cooling water source, named operator, NSSS vendor, start year.

name: EMODnet urban waste water treatment plants
description: UWWTD plants: uwwcode, uwwname, country, status, capacit_pe, treatment level, nremoval/premoval flags, UV/chlorination/ozonation/sand/micro filtration flags, and compliance pass-fail per parameter (bod5_tp, cod_tp, tss_tp, ntot_tp, ptot_tp) with load in population equivalent. Regulatory compliance per named facility.

name: EMODnet waste water discharge points
description: Discharge outfalls: dcpcode, dcpname, country, NUTS3 region, state, year, the uwwcode of the plant discharging (join key to treatmentplants), receiving water body type and id, WFD river basin district, sensitive-area classification and source dataset version.

name: EMODnet desalination plants
description: Desalination facilities: objectid, location and comm_name, country, NUTS3, project name, award_date and online_date, location_type, capacity_m3d, unit count and unit_size_m3d, technology (RO etc.), feedwater type, plant_status and customer_type.

name: EMODnet marine aggregate extraction
description: Sand and gravel extraction sites: areaid, extraction_area name, country, sea basin, year, material, area_of_activity_km2, permitted vs requested vs actually extracted amounts in m3 and tonnes, extraction_type and distance to coast. Licence-vs-actual volumes per named area.

name: EMODnet dumped munitions
description: Located munitions on the European seabed: munition_type, free-text description (calibre, dimensions, chemical or not, condition, whether neutralised or blasted), reporting date and infoprov source (OSPAR), distance to coast.

name: EMODnet port locations
description: Port point registry with port_id (BE003, BEANR...), port and portname, country, coordinates, data source and a traffic flag. port_id is the join key into EMODnet's portgoods / portvessels / portpassengers throughput tables.

name: EMODnet lighthouses
description: Navigational light structures with arlhs_number, name, country, status (removed/relocated/destroyed or not), distance_to_shore_m, position relative to coastline and comments.

name: EMODnet ocean energy projects
description: Wave and tidal energy installations as points with country, sea basin, project attributes and coordinates. Companion layer to oenergytests.

name: EMODnet UK subsea fibre and power cables
description: Cable routes with pipe id and pipe_dtino, name, descriptive text of the endpoints ("EIDER PLATFORM TO OTTER TEMPLATE POWER CABLE P1"), diameter, fluid/type (FIBRE), status, exposed and untrenched flags and the named operator.

name: EMODnet Dutch (Rijkswaterstaat) subsea cables
description: Netherlands-sourced submarine cable route geometry with the Rijkswaterstaat attribute set. One of five national cable layers on this WFS (bshcontiscables DE, shomcables FR, sigcables, maltacables, rijkscables NL, ukfibrecables GB).

name: EMODnet French (SHOM) subsea cables
description: French hydrographic service cable routes as MultiLineString with catcbl category code, status and the INSPIRE feature id.

name: EMODnet German (BSH CONTIS) subsea cables
description: German Bight and Baltic cable corridors from the BSH CONTIS register, high-vertex MultiLineString geometry with the CONTIS attribute set.

name: EMODnet worldwide shipwrecks
description: Wreck register: wreck_id, wreck_cate (dangerous/non-dangerous), status, position and horizontal datum, depth with method/quality/accuracy, water_dept, water level regime, vessel name, type, flag state, length, width, draught and sonar dimensions.

name: EMODnet military areas (polygons)
description: Declared military and defence zones at sea as MultiPolygon with country (and up to three claiming countries), status, up to three type classifications (National Defence Area, exercise area...) and a resource URL to the declaring authority's chart.

name: EMODnet aquaculture zones
description: Licensed aquaculture production areas as MultiPolygon with country, species group and zone attributes. 337 KB even at count=3 because of polygon density.

name: OpenAlex work by DOI (id pivot)
description: Same full work record but keyed by DOI instead of OpenAlex id - lets you enter the OpenAlex graph from any Crossref/DataCite DOI you already hold and come back out with authors, institutions, funders and the referenced_works edge list.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex works by author id
description: Every work attributed to one OpenAlex author id (meta.count=68 for the probe), each row a full work object with co-authors, their institutions and countries, funders and citation counts. The author->publications hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex institution record (detail)
description: One institution: ROR id, country, type, homepage, acronyms and alternative names, lineage (parent institutions), geo coordinates, works/cited-by counts, associated_institutions and repositories.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex institution -> associated institutions / roles
description: Trimmed institution record exposing the org-graph edges: associated_institutions (each with id, ROR, country, type and relationship=parent/child/related) plus the institution's roles as funder/publisher/institution. Turns one university into its hospital, campus and institute network.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex institutions under a parent (lineage)
description: All 19 institutions whose lineage contains Kyoto University - the sub-institutes, hospitals and centres rolled up under one parent org, each a full institution record with ROR and geo.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex institution by ROR id
description: Resolve a bare ROR identifier to the full OpenAlex institution record (works counts, lineage, geo, associated institutions). The ROR->OpenAlex join key.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex works by institution ROR
description: All works with at least one author affiliated to a given ROR org (meta.count=499,568 for U. Washington), full work objects with co-author institutions and countries. Institution->output hop keyed on ROR rather than OpenAlex id.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAlex authors at an institution

This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Crossref work record (detail)

The DOI->funding+licence hop.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: DataCite DOIs deposited by one repository

Repository->holdings hop; combined with provider->clients it enumerates a whole national consortium's data output.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: DataCite DOIs under one provider organisation
description: All DOIs across every repository belonging to one provider org, full records including contributors and affiliations. Institution-level research-output sweep.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: DataCite DOIs related to a given DOI
description: Finds datasets, software and theses that declare a relationship to a target DOI (IsSupplementTo, Cites, IsDerivedFrom ...). The data-behind-the-paper hop, reversed.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: DataCite DOIs by creator ORCID
description: Datasets and software authored by a specific ORCID, full records with affiliation. Researcher->data-output hop that Crossref cannot answer.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: DataCite repositories directory
description: Global directory of data repositories with symbol, re3data/OpenDOAR ids, client type, languages, certificates, domains, ISSNs, url and repository software. Registry of who is holding research data worldwide.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: DataCite DOI prefix registry
description: Every DataCite DOI prefix with creation date and relationships to its clients and providers - attribution of an arbitrary DOI prefix to the organisation behind it.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: DataCite DOI search with affiliation+publisher expansion
description: Fielded Elasticsearch query over DataCite with affiliation=true and publisher=true, which expands the creator affiliation objects and publisher entity inline instead of returning bare strings.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ROR organisation record (v1 detail)
description: Authoritative research-org record: established year, all external ids (Crossref Fundref ids, GRID, ISNI, Wikidata), names in multiple scripts, relationships to parent/child/related orgs, geonames location with lat/lng and country subdivision, website links, admin/schema versions.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ROR organisation record (v2 detail, bare id)
description: Same record via the v2 path taking a bare ROR id (no url prefix) - the form you get from an OpenAlex or DataCite affiliation field. Includes the fundref id array which joins straight into Crossref funder queries.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ROR v2 organisation search
description: Free-text org search returning 122 hits as full v2 records (external ids, locations, links, relationships) - the name->ROR-id resolver that then feeds OpenAlex, Crossref and DataCite affiliation filters.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ROR organisations by type + country
description: 1,546 Japanese education-type organisations, full records with fundref/GRID/ISNI/Wikidata cross-ids and geonames. Enumerates a country's higher-education sector as a joinable id list.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GLEIF direct-child RELATIONSHIP records
description: All 330 direct-subsidiary relationship edges for a parent LEI as relationship objects (start/end node, type, status, validity and accounting periods) rather than plain child records - the dated corporate-structure graph beneath a group.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GLEIF ultimate children of a LEI
description: 416 entities that name this LEI as their ULTIMATE consolidating parent (vs 330 direct) - full LEI records with legal name, addresses, legal form and registration status. The whole group, not just tier one.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GLEIF LEI field modification history
description: 164 dated change events for one LEI: which field changed, from what value to what value, when. Detects quiet renames, address moves, status flips and legal-form changes - the audit trail behind a company record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GLEIF reverse ownership lookup (filter[owns])
description: Given a LEI, returns the LEI records of entities that OWN it (2 owners for the probe) as full records. Reverse of the parent hop and the cheapest way to walk upward through an opaque holding chain.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GLEIF LEI lookup by ISIN (security -> issuer)
description: Resolves a traded security's ISIN to the issuing legal entity's full LEI record (US0378331005 -> Apple Inc., with former names, addresses, legal form and registration status). Security->issuer->corporate-group entry point.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GLEIF full-text LEI search
description: Full-text search across the whole LEI record (names, addresses, other names) - 408 hits for Toyota, each a complete record. Broader recall than the exact legalName filter the tree already uses.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GLEIF search across ALL entity names (incl. former/other)
description: Searches legal name plus otherNames and transliteratedOtherNames (291 hits) - catches entities that have been renamed or that trade under a different local-script name.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GLEIF LEIs with LAPSED registration
description: 1,191,703 entities that stopped renewing their LEI - full records. A lapsed LEI on an entity still doing regulated business is a due-diligence signal, and the set is a ready-made watchlist.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: GLEIF non-conforming LEI records

This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Europe PMC citations of an article

name: Europe PMC reference list of an article

A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Europe PMC core record (full metadata)
description: resultType=core returns the deep record: abstract, full author list with first/last names and affiliations, grants list (agency, grant id, acronym), MeSH terms, chemicals, full text ids, licence, and comment/correction links. Much richer than the lite search rows already in the tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Europe PMC works by grant ID

name: Europe PMC works by funding agency

name: OpenCitations Meta bibliographic record

Deduplicates works across identifier systems.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenCitations Meta works by author ORCID
description: All works Meta attributes to one ORCID, each with co-authors (with their own ORCIDs and omids), venue, date and type. A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAIRE Graph research products search
description: 1.93M hits; each result is a merged research product with authors and their ORCIDs, type, language, descriptions, subjects with provenance, pids, publication venue, and the OpenAIRE id used for project/organisation joins.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAIRE research product by DOI/PID (detail)
description: Resolves any persistent identifier to OpenAIRE's deduplicated record: full author list each with ORCID and its provenance (orcid vs orcid_pending), instances across every repository holding it, licence, and links to funding projects. name: OpenAIRE Graph funded projects search

This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAIRE project by id (detail)

name: OpenAIRE research products BY project id

name: OpenAIRE organizations search
description: 118 org records for a name query: legal name, legal short name, website, country, OpenAIRE org id, pids and originalIds. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: OpenAIRE data sources search
description: Repositories and aggregators OpenAIRE harvests: official/English name, type scheme, OpenAIRE compatibility level, website, logo, original ids. name: CORDIS project search with keyword clause

This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CORDIS project RESULTS (outcomes) search
description: 7,691 reported project outcomes, each carrying relatedProjectAcronym, relatedProjectReference and relatedProjectRcn plus the outcome teaser - the deliverables-behind-a-grant hop, and it links back to the parent project id.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: theses.fr doctoral thesis search (FR)
description: 1,057 French PhD theses: NNT id, title in FR and EN, awarding institution with its PPN, defence date, first-enrolment date, and the people - auteurs, directeurs, rapporteurs, jury - each with their IdRef PPN. Person-level academic-lineage data not present anywhere in the tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: theses.fr person search (FR academics)
description: 568 people with IdRef PPN, has_idref flag, a roles map counting how often they served as author/supervisor/examiner/reporter, and the NNT list of every thesis they touched. Academic-influence network for France.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

description: 563,354 records reachable with the filtres= syntax (status, institution, year). Demonstrates the filter grammar needed to sweep the corpus rather than keyword-search it.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

Requires at least one of material/article/author/affil/keyword/abst/text/issn/cdjournal (otherwise ERR_012).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

description: 377KB: every volume and issue of a Japanese journal with dates and issue-level urls - the journal->issue->article drilldown. Requires cdjournal or issn (ERR_011 otherwise).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

description: 939KB directory of Japanese scholarly journals with cdjournal code, ISSN, publisher society name in JA and EN, and coverage years. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

description: Every curated list an entity belongs to (Fortune 1000, donor lists, board networks) with list id, description, entity_count and ranking flag. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: LittleSis entity type extensions

This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Unpaywall OA location for a DOI

description: Live 311 case feed: service_request_id, status, status_notes, service_name, service_code, description (free text, frequently contains licence plates, vehicle descriptions and named complaints), requested_datetime, updated_datetime, address, lat/long, media_url. A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see docs/verified-sources-batch16.md. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: San Francisco 311 - single service request

This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Austin Police Dept reported crimes (city ArcGIS FeatureServer, non-Socrata)
description: CRIME_INCIDENT_POINTS_ID, RIN (report incident number), OCCURRENCE_DATE, OCCURRENCE_TIME, OCCURRENCE_WEEK_DAY, ADDRESS_BLOCK, offence fields and point geometry. name: New York State DEC - remediation sites and spills
